sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and respondent No.2 in both the petitions in unison would submit that the parties to the lis have settled the disputes among themselves and a joint memo to that effect is filed before this Court.
The conditions of the settlement also recognize the present proceedings impugned in both the petitions.

3. The terms of the joint memo, read as follows:
"i. The Respondent No.2 agrees and state that he has no objection to quash the proceedings in CC No.22420/2021 pending before the III Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Tumkur for the offences punishable under Section 143, 147, 323, 324, 504,
506, 427 of Indian Penal Code against the Petitioners in Criminal Petition No.528/2023.
ii.

sentences.text: 354. 498- A and 504 of Indian Penal Code against the Petitioners in Criminal Petition No.9208/2022.

The Petitioners and Respondent No.2 in Criminal Petition 528/2023 and the Petitioners and Respondent No.2 in Criminal Petition 9208/2022 have agreed and undertaken that they will be have no claims whatsoever against each other, and they will not indulge in filing any cases, complaints against each other on whatsoever grounds."

In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties, in both the petitions, I deem it appropriate to dispose NC: 2023:KHC:19159 the petitions by quashing the impugned proceedings initiated against each other.

4. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER a. The criminal petitions are disposed.

b. The proceedings in C.C.No.22420/2021, pending on the file of the III Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Tumkur and the proceedings in C.C.No.37374/2021, pending on the file of the VI Additional C.M.M., Benglauru, stand quashed.
